correctness.rationale: For every field of characteristic two and arbitrary finite quiver, direct basis expansion yields c_v in {0,1} and arrow coefficient (c_u^2+c_uc_v+c_v^2-1)r_alpha. Exactly the arrows outside the zero-induced subquiver are free. A second proof via e=a^2, n=a+a^2 in eJe verifies the incidence fibers, and 1+J conjugation gives exact orbit parameters. Direct enumeration of 12 packaged finite fields checks all multiplication identities but is auxiliary, not the infinite proof. The reduced variety, not the defining scheme, is asserted.

value.rationale: The natural tripotent element locus of all characteristic-two radical-square-zero quiver algebras acquires a complete geometric component profile and finite-field census. Its highest-dimensional irreducible components correspond bijectively to graph independent sets, giving a parsimonious #P-completeness consequence even for simple-graph orientations. Internal-arrow degrees of freedom exhibit inseparability and distinguish this problem from known idempotent or odd-characteristic analogues.
